## Context / Problem
Eighteen reusable and operational workflow files contain explanatory comments that mix current contracts with repetition, narration, or history. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@d6669496cae4`, including the Terraform-config-inspect canary appended to `_optionality.yml`.

## Approach
Edit only allowlisted standalone explanatory comments and adjacent blank lines. Keep current non-obvious rationale, security boundaries, failure semantics, portability constraints, and operator-visible contracts. Preserve all workflow data, embedded shell, expressions, permissions, triggers, action pins, assertions, user-facing output, and directives byte-for-byte.

Preserve these behavior-bearing directive lines exactly:
- `_artifact-probe.yml`: both `shellcheck disable=SC1091` lines.
- `_mutation.yml` and `gerrit-verify.yaml`: all four `predates-gate-ok` markers.
- `gerrit-verify.yaml`, `prompt-eval.yml`, and `_optionality.yml`: all five complete `mechanism-ok: ci_gate` markers, including the three Terraform-canary markers.

## Scope
- `_artifact-probe.yml` — Preserve secret-free exact-patchset checkout, sdist-first build, baked-commit/metadata checks, installed archive probes, schema/import walk, and shellcheck directives.
- `_build-and-test.yml` — Preserve secret-free exact checkout; online-token versus portable local lint; pre-commit skips; old-patchset guards; ownership-routed dependency advisories; enforced sandbox proof; Linux/macOS, coverage, extras, and Node lanes; browser opt-out record; patchset timeout; integration isolation; Gerrit report coverage; trusted-main docs restore; and generated/parity/security gates.
- `_eval-discipline.yml` — Preserve both callers, secret/model-free exact-patchset evaluation, named offline subset, and 300-second thread bound.
- `_mutation.yml` — Preserve changed/all shard selection, empty-selection skip, 30-minute shards, always-uploaded evidence, hosted-Ubuntu namespace waiver, and exact predates marker.
- `_optionality.yml` — Preserve fork-safe checkout; clean no-extra wheel and heavy-dependency absence; old-patchset guards; no-agents degradation; isolated per-extra environments, union resolution, absolute interpreters, and aggregated failure. Also condense the shell-comment block before the Terraform canary's if-present guard while preserving the main-definition/patchset-tree mismatch rationale, early skip before installs, all canary workflow data, the pinned upstream binary, opt-in environment, and three exact mechanism markers.
- `codeql.yml` — Preserve schedule/manual-only triggering, six-hour staggering, cancellation, Python/JavaScript matrix, path config, read-only permissions with job-local security-event write, and intentional major action tags.
- `compact-sweep.yml` — Preserve out-of-band single flight; full-history ticket merge; harmless 60-minute bound; sweep-only write; optional signing; dry-run/limit inputs; exit-2 warning versus exit-1 failure; no-pipe capture; always-written summary; and operation-linked no-CI fallback. It publishes no metrics.
- `dependency-advisory-canary.yml` — Preserve daily/manual dry-run, single flight, writable full-history store, optional signing, deduplicated lifecycle/comment cap, release-only blocking, merge-not-rebase retry flush, and visible red result. The audit step remains `continue-on-error`; the alert step must fail closed.
- `external-integration.yml` — Preserve manual/weekly billable boundary; provider isolation and loud missing/all-skip failure; committed overlays; Bedrock-only OIDC and regions; complementary partitions, per-test timeouts, usage evidence; Langfuse/Jira teardown; scoped S3 and Jira Cloud cleanup; and Linux/macOS Pandoc replay.
- `gerrit-verify.yaml` — Preserve authoritative patchset identity; exact checkout; trusted-main classifier/normalizer/vote code; secret confinement; exclusive routing; complete `vote.needs`; fail-closed conclusions; closed-change race handling; non-voting observability; and exact markers.
- `jira-dc-capability-map.yml` — Preserve manual amd64 authoring, pinned harness, required Anthropic access, bounded agent run, read-only repository store, teardown, and artifact.
- `jira-dc-epic-link-probe.yml` — Preserve the manual stdlib/four-call disposable-Jira probe, no LLM or repository mutation, teardown, and artifact.
- `jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml` — Preserve mirror-first/Gerrit-fallback exact fetch/SHA verification; mismatch/all-skip failure; DC extra; isolated no-remotes suite; teardown; additive non-Verified role; and summary/log evidence.
- `jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml` — Preserve manual Anthropic investigation, shared harness, direct-provider overlay, read-only repository store, bounded run, evidence upload, and teardown.
- `mirror-guard.yml` — Preserve 15-minute/manual replication checks, multiple samples, public/default-token reads, cancellation, and exclusion of admin-only ruleset drift.
- `optionality.yml` — Preserve mirror caller filters, pull requests, manual/staggered health, read-only/no-vote posture, and branch-head reusable invocation.
- `prompt-eval.yml` — Preserve offline branch/PR/manual evaluation; advisory same-repo changed-rubric evaluation; canonical weekly/manual live evaluation; sequential cases, cap 12, provider dollar caps, summaries/artifacts, concurrency, and exact marker.
- `reconcile-bridge-canary.yml` — Preserve rollback input, cadence/window, single flight, write/read permissions, full-history store, optional signing, consecutive-red lifecycle, binding fsck, synchronous merge-not-rebase push, dry-run, and terminal stale red.

Paths are relative to `.github/workflows/`. Consumers are GitHub Actions, repository policy tests, bridge/runtime code, and operators.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] DD `comment-only-diff` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `directive-preservation` exits 0.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and named consumer has a leaf-linked TSV row with full before/final citations.
- [ ] Every required TSV row has a non-empty `reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Every `reviewer_session` identifies a reviewer who did not author the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has one TSV row satisfying `before_words > after_words`.
- [ ] Every edited-block row records `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every edited-block row records `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] No required TSV row is missing.
- [ ] DD `workflow-contracts-core` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `workflow-contracts-gerrit` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `workflow-contracts-jira-dc` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `workflow-contracts-canary` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `workflow-contracts-parity` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `diff-integrity` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `repository-gate` exits 0 without a timeout.

## Verification
Run the recorded deterministic commands. The independent TSV, not exact prose retention, is authoritative for concision and semantic preservation.
